fields.FIR_Description: A online complaint dated 2025-11-12 states that the complainant received an SMS with a link resembling a bank notification; after entering card details on the page, Rs. 12,000 was debited, on 2025-11-12 around 16:30 hrs. Nandhini Selvi submitted the complaint online using the mobile number 9000000239. Transaction details refer to the receiving account SYN-ACC-100083. Vasanth Gopal (mobile 9000000245) was named as a possible person of interest. A further person, Sanjay Mani, an intermediary, using the number 9000000120, is stated to be associated with the incident. No supporting material was reported at the time of registration. Records suggest a possible link with FIR-2026-00095, as the mobile number 9000000245 is associated with a suspect in both entries.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Victim reported receiving a suspicious link that imitated a bank notification.
fields.Keywords: phishing, suspicious link, associate, main street, mobile number, afternoon, receiving account, suspect
